actions.name: CONFIRM_UPLOAD_DATE

actions.name: RECORD_CHANGE

actions.webOnly: selected immutable records only; 2 changed fields => 2 output rows

actions.name: HISTORICAL_MANUAL_AND_LATE_LINK

actions.name: PROPOSAL_BASELINE_AND_FORECAST

actions.name: CONFIRM_WORKFLOW_PROGRESS
actions.webOnly: Explicit manual report/ECOUNT/native completion confirmations append actor/time/date; output never completes stages; native confirmation stores separate observed snapshot and forecast difference
